prompt:

Asset type: one native high-resolution transparent anime character MASTER BACK VIEW, single complete figure on exact 1024x1536 canvas.
Input images: Image 1 is the finished FRONT master and controls the exact character scale, body proportions, landmark heights, costume size, hand size, colors, linework and high-resolution finish. Image 2 is the DESIGN AUTHORITY three-view sheet: its BACK view controls all rear accessory and clothing design. Rotate the same three-dimensional character to a straight rear view; never copy front-facing ornaments onto the back.
Primary request: draw this exact cat girl standing neutrally, seen directly from behind, one complete full-body figure. This is not a character sheet. Native clean high-resolution linework with white-lavender curls, cream clothing and rich green details matching Image 1.
Registration: center body at x512; ear tips y15–30, inferred chin height y450, shoulders y520–530, natural waist and waistband y690–700, lower posterior pelvis y850, skirt hem/ruffles y1070–1110, shoe soles y1480. POSE AND ANATOMY: straight stable rear stand, head upright. Both complete arms connect from the appropriate shoulder through elbow to wrist, relaxed down about 15 degrees away from the body. Show normal sleeve shoulder structure, not a floating cuff or an arm starting from hair. Hands small and softly relaxed with one thumb and four fingers each, natural overlap allowed, no fist and no spread palm aimed at the camera. Both complete legs attach correctly to the pelvis, relaxed uncrossed knees, stable parallel stance and a small natural gap. The viewer sees the heels and backs of both shoes.
REAR DESIGN LOCK: preserve the long white-lavender wavy hair silhouette of Image 2 with the same large layered curls and length, detailed and coherent with Image 1. Let curls fall naturally to both sides so a narrow central lower-back window remains visible; do not cut the hair short. White cat ears show their OUTER white furry backs, not pink interiors. The side hair bows remain at their original ear-base attachment sites; from behind show only their green ribbon backs/side edges, NO white daisy facing backward.
Rear sailor collar is one green flap edged by the same thin white trim. Cream long-sleeved dress and the SAME narrow plain green waistband across the back. The waistband has NO rear bow, NO knot, NO central flower, NO extra ornament. The two front waist bows and the chest bow are hidden from this rear view.
TAIL ROOT IS ESSENTIAL: at the center of the LOWER POSTERIOR PELVIS, around x512,y850, about 150px below the waistband, draw a small narrow neatly cream-bound tail opening in the BACK SKIRT PANEL. It must be anatomically below the waist and above the skirt hem. The bound opening is a compact rounded eyelet about 30–45px across, never a big slit or huge triangle. Clearly show a short white-lavender furred root segment EXITING this opening before it turns gently downward. The opening rim must remain visibly readable around the first short root. Hair leaves a natural narrow window showing the opening. ONE tail continues from that exact root into a modest soft down-sweep, slightly curving toward viewer-left as in Image 2, ending around y1320–1360. Tail is not attached to waistband, sleeve, wrist, skirt hem or calf, and does not pass through hands, hair or sleeves.
Skirt back: match Image 2's rear arrangement and Image 1's finish: one large green daisy with yellow center on EACH rear side and two small companion daisies on each side, above the broad green hem band with its thin white line trim and the cream ruffled lower edge. Keep flower count, sizes and placement coherent across the back. A single tail may naturally cover a small part of the central skirt, but no central extra flower. No front bows visible on back.
Opaque white tights. Same chunky green Mary Jane shoes, green heel/sole construction and thin yellow piping; rear view shows heel cups and heel soles, daisy ornaments only at their genuine OUTER side edges if visible, not newly placed on back heels.
Background: real alpha transparency outside the physical character. No backdrop, checkerboard, ground, cast shadow, glow, aura, text, labels, watermark, guide marks, extra limbs or second figure.
validation: pending visual review, not animation acceptance
